remarks: Beautifully designed home blending thoughtful design, craftsmanship & function. Features dbl attached garage w/ floor drain, sep side entry, 9' ceilings & vinyl plank flooring thru main. Spacious foyer offers lrg coat closet, nearby 2-pce bath & mud rm w/ garage access, connecting to a walk-thru pantry & kitchen. Open-concept kitchen, nook & great rm feature quartz counters, central island w/ flush eating ledge, built-in microwave, Silgranit sink, pendant lighting, soft-close Thermofoil cabinets, chimney-style hood fan & full-height tile backsplash. Great rm boasts a cozy FP, while lrg windows & sliding patio doors brighten the nook & lead to the backyard. Upstairs offers an open-to-below view, primary suite w/ 4-pce ensuite, dbl sinks, W/I shower & W/I closet connected to laundry. Two addl bdrms, 4-pce bath, upgraded railings & bsmt rough-in for future bath/2nd laundry complete the home. (id:67522)
